question: Westfalia Fruit Group founded location headquarters
markdown:
The
⁠Westfalia Fruit Group
was founded in
1949
by Dr. Hans Merensky on the
Westfalia Estate near Duiwelskloof (now Modjadjiskloof) near Tzaneen in Limpopo,
South Africa
. The group maintains dual corporate roots and key operational headquarters in both
Johannesburg, South Africa
and
Kent, England (UK)
